page.layout: One page of text, a title block at the top followed by a list of chapter headings in one column; no margin notes.
page.head: SVMMA RERVM TRACTATARVM CAPITA, quæ in hoc libro tractantur.
page.l: De Synodis bis in anno celebrandis.
De Gratia, Remissione peccatorum, & sola fide iustificante.
De primatu in ecclesia & de Papa.
page.notes: The title is set in large spaced capitals with the italic line "tractantur." below it; the heading is written as a level 1 head. The last line "De" stands alone at the lower right, apparently a catchword for the next page. Some letters at the top edge are ghosted show-through and were left out. The word "tractantur" is printed with a long-tailed ligature shape, read as "tractantur".
